attchmntText: Jagran Prakashan Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation in connection with the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jagran Prakashan Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The filing was submitted to the BSE and NSE pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. Consolidated operating revenue increased by 6% to Rs. 493.44 crores in Q2FY27. Profit after tax declined by 25% to Rs. 42.82 crores. The group maintains net cash of more than Rs. 1,000 crores. Radio City reported an 8% growth in operating revenue. Digital revenue rose by 24%. Outdoor and Events revenue grew by 10%. The presentation is available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Jagran Prakashan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release dated November 13, 2026, in connection with the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026.".
voiceSummary: Jagran Prakashan Limited filed a press release with BSE and NSE regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated operating revenues for Q2FY27 were Rs 493.44 crores, up 5.6% from Rs 467.36 crores. Advertisement revenues rose 6.1% to Rs 346.69 crores. Circulation revenues were Rs 80.25 crores. Digital revenue increased 23.6% to Rs 26.81 crores. Operating profit was Rs 57.32 crores, down from Rs 66.58 crores. Profit before tax was Rs 58.18 crores. Profit after tax was Rs 42.82 crores. Earnings per share were Rs 1.89. For H1FY27, consolidated operating revenues were Rs 992.79 crores. Profit after tax was Rs 104.05 crores. The company received 16 awards during the quarter. CRISIL reaffirmed its credit rating.

attchmntText: Jagran Prakashan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jagran Prakashan Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November, 2026. Statutory Auditors Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP conducted a Limited Review. For the half-year ended 30th September, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 92,043.29 Lakhs. Profit before tax was Rs. 17,251.81 Lakhs. Profit for the period was Rs. 13,307.28 Lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 10.91. The company noted a legal petition pending before the National Company Law Tribunal regarding the removal of directors. An appeal is pending before the Supreme Court with the next hearing scheduled for 19th November, 2026. Management expects no impact on financial results.
